'''Foothill Town''' (Japanese: '''フタバタウン''' ''Futaba Town'') is a small {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive town in [[Hoenn]] that was visited by {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} in ''[[AG060|Delcatty Got Your Tongue]]''. It is located between [[Mauville City]] and [[Verdanturf Town]].

While on their way to Verdanturf Town for {{an|May}}'s next [[Pokémon Contest]], {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} were confronted by {{TRT}}. They battled them, but during the battle, [[May's Skitty]] got injured by the smoke of [[Ash's Torkoal]]. They defeated Team Rocket and hurried themselves to find the nearest [[Pokémon Center]] to get help for Skitty.

They hoped to find one in Foothill Town, but they learned from a local that the town lacks a Pokémon Center. They did, however, find out that there is a Pokémon Clinic at the edge of the town, run by [[Dr. Abby]], a {{tc|Doctor|Pokémon Doctor}} who specializes in natural medicine and a [[Top Coordinator]]. After helping Skitty regain its voice, Abby sat down to chat with the group and revealed that she won the [[Hoenn Grand Festival]]. She later helped Skitty to learn {{m|Blizzard}}.
